"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import styles from "./Pricing.module.css";

type Billing = "monthly" | "yearly";

interface Tier {
  name: string;
  monthly: number;
  yearly: number;
  blurb: string;
  featured: boolean;
}

// Placeholder tiers and prices: replace with the co-op's real plans.
const TIERS: Tier[] = [
  { name: "Supporter", monthly: 5, yearly: 50, blurb: "Back the workshop and join Saturday sessions.", featured: false },
  { name: "Member", monthly: 12, yearly: 120, blurb: "Open workshop access with a volunteer beside you.", featured: true },
  { name: "Household", monthly: 20, yearly: 200, blurb: "Everyone at your address, one membership.", featured: false },
];

export default function Pricing() {
  const [billing, setBilling] = useState<Billing>("monthly");
  const isYearly = billing === "yearly";

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="pricing-title" className={styles.section}>
      <h2 id="pricing-title" className={styles.title}>
        Membership
      </h2>

      <div className={styles.toggle} role="group" aria-label="Billing period">
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-pressed={!isYearly}
          className={styles.toggleBtn}
          onClick={() => setBilling("monthly")}
        >
          Monthly
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-pressed={isYearly}
          className={styles.toggleBtn}
          onClick={() => setBilling("yearly")}
        >
          Yearly
        </button>
      </div>

      <ul className={styles.grid}>
        {TIERS.map((tier) => (
          <li
            key={tier.name}
            className={tier.featured ? styles.featured : styles.tier}
          >
            <h3>{tier.name}</h3>
            <p className={styles.blurb}>{tier.blurb}</p>
            <p className={styles.price} aria-live="polite">
              <span className={styles.amount}>
                ${isYearly ? tier.yearly : tier.monthly}
              </span>
              <span className={styles.per}>{isYearly ? " / year" : " / month"}</span>
            </p>
            <a className={styles.cta} href="#join">
              Join as {tier.name}
            </a>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
